title: COVERAGE-TRACE: Source-Side Counterfactual Tracing for Detecting Omissions in LLM Summaries
abstract: arXiv:2611.25539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omissions are difficult to verify because missing information leaves no output span to inspect: a summary may be factually supported while still excluding a decision, qualification, quantity, or condition needed to preserve the source's meaning. We introduce COVERAGE-TRACE, a source-side counterfactual framework that evaluates omission as dependence on a designated atomic source fact. It replaces only the target fact with type-matched alternatives, holds the candidate summary fixed, and measures the resulting change in its teacher-forced, length-normalized likelihood. A summary covering the target should respond more strongly than one omitting it, while aggregation across multiple counterfactuals reduces sensitivity to replacement choice.   We evaluate COVERAGE-TRACE on 80 matched covered--omitted QMSum pairs spanning several fact types and four open-weight models. Multi-CF achieves 0.764--0.825 AUROC, compared with 0.640 for the stronge

translated_title: COVERAGE-TRACE：基于源文本侧反事实追踪的大语言模型摘要遗漏检测方法
translated_abstract: 遗漏难以验证，因为缺失的信息不会留下可供检查的输出片段：一份摘要在事实层面可能是有依据的，却仍然遗漏了保持原文含义所必需的决策、限定条件、数量或条件。我们提出COVERAGE-TRACE，这是一个源文本侧的反事实框架，将遗漏评估为摘要对指定原子源事实的依赖程度。该方法仅用类型匹配的替代内容替换目标事实，同时保持候选摘要不变，并测量其教师强制、长度归一化似然所产生的变化。覆盖目标事实的摘要应比遗漏该事实的摘要产生更强的反应，而跨多个反事实样本的聚合则降低了对替换选择的敏感性。我们在80对匹配的覆盖-遗漏QMSum样本（涵盖多种事实类型）和四个开放权重模型上评估了COVERAGE-TRACE。Multi-CF方法达到了0.764–0.825的AUROC，而强基线仅为0.640。
tldr: 提出COVERAGE-TRACE源侧反事实框架，通过替换源文本原子事实并测量摘要似然变化来检测大语言模型摘要中的遗漏，在QMSum数据集上达到0.764–0.825的AUROC，显著优于强基线的0.640。
en_tdlr: COVERAGE-TRACE is a source-side counterfactual framework that detects omissions in LLM summaries by replacing atomic source facts and measuring likelihood changes, achieving 0.764–0.825 AUROC on QMSum, substantially outperforming the 0.640 strong baseline.
